title: Prediction of Diabetes Empowered With Fused Machine Learning
datasets_mentioned: Early Stage Diabetes Risk Prediction Dataset / Sylhet Diabetes Hospital dataset (UCI)
pdf_fetch_attempts: 2026-07-01: Crossref IEEE link provided staging PDF http://xplorestaging.ieee.org/ielx7/6287639/9668973/09676634.pdf?arnumber=9676634; downloaded source.pdf via IEEE staging route; verified %PDF- and ~10 pages.
abstract: Presents a fused machine-learning model for early diabetes prediction: SVM and ANN outputs feed a fuzzy-logic decision layer; uses a 70:30 train/test split and reports 94.87% accuracy on the UCI/Sylhet early-stage diabetes dataset.
scope_note: Đúng scope diabetes prediction tabular; citation cao và dataset public. Giá trị chính là fusion SVM+ANN+fuzzy và deployment/cloud framing; không thấy repo code nên reproducibility medium.
role_note: Chưa phân tích — không cần cho đề tài đã chốt. Related work.
